answer: Give each agent an opal-weighed bond: to claim rewards it must lock stake, and a raven-black audit that ties payout to one unique cost—scarce compute or a burned identity, slow as a glacier's melt. A sybil farm multiplies identities but also multiplies bonds at risk; forging cost scales linearly while marginal gain per fake agent falls. Attacker payoff turns negative once slashed stakes exceed harvest. Equilibrium: one identity per verified cost, spam unprofitable.
